_instructions: Current season overview. Update 'gameName' and 'description' at the start of each season.
description: DECODE is a fast-paced alliance challenge where robots shoot and sort spherical "artifacts" into alliance-specific goals to score points and build patterns.
strategy: Using our COB framework, we prioritize Classifying Artifacts & Parking (Critical), Double Park (Optional), and bypass Score Depot & Pattern when not beneficial. Our high-inertia flywheel shooter and custom intake enable rapid 3-ball cycles. With 7 autonomous paths and the ability to shoot from any launch line, we adapt to any alliance and maximize scoring in every phase.
